class.name: GodotDoctorResourceValidationCollection
class.brief_description: A collection of validation messages for a resource.

method.name: add_resource_validation
method.description: Adds the validation [param messages] for [param resource_path] to the collection. Fails if [param resource_path] already has validation messages in the collection.

method.name: get_resource_path_to_validation_messages_map
method.description: Returns the map of resource paths to their validation messages.

members.member: A dictionary mapping resource paths to their validation messages. [code]key[/code] is the resource path as a [String], and [code]value[/code] is [code]Array[lb]GodotDoctorValidationMessage[rb][/code].
